vehicle_survival.evidence: - If a prone/stompable target is in the swipe lane, start `CurbStomp`.
- Else if an attacking enemy is in the block lane, block/parry toward that enemy.
The Godot lane search widens with forward distance. The port should preserve this shape:
- Auto-turn is capped at `30deg` when one target is in lane
- When multiple targets are in lane, keep the requested swipe/attack direction and only use the best target for lane selection
